about: Directory of pages the monthly open-calls scraper visits. Edit freely on GitHub: add a source by copying an entry, set active:false to pause one. mode 'fetch' = read the url directly; mode 'search' = the site blocks automated reading, so the scraper runs the query with web search instead. months = only check in these months (1-12); omit to check every run.

sources.name: On the Move — deadlines
sources.notes: Best single source. Grouped by category, ~60 dated calls. Also scan https://on-the-move.org/news (6 pages) for new posts.

sources.name: TransArtists — open calls
sources.notes: Sorted by posting date; read the first 2-3 pages. Deadlines list: https://www.transartists.org/en/deadlines

sources.name: Res Artis — open calls
sources.notes: ~120 calls, many pay-to-stay. Propose fully funded programmes only.

sources.name: British Electroacoustic Network — opportunities
sources.notes: Best sound-specific listing (source of Forum Wallis and Xenakis). Skip UK-residents-only calls.

sources.name: Artificial Nouveau — EU grants
sources.notes: ~170 curated grants and residencies, all disciplines.

sources.name: ArtConnect — residencies and grants
sources.notes: Relative deadlines only ('in 4 days'): open each call for the date. Also /opportunities/grant-or-stipend. Many fee-based photo calls.

sources.name: Reviewed by Artists — open calls
sources.notes: Only ~5 calls visible without a paid account; low yield, keep as a cross-check.

sources.name: SALTO — European training calendar
sources.notes: Erasmus+ trainings for youth workers (WILD:CARE). Dates are event dates; open each for the application deadline. Filter 'creativity & arts'.

sources.name: Creative Europe — calls
sources.query: Creative Europe call for proposals artists individuals open 2027
sources.notes: culture.ec.europa.eu renders its list with JavaScript, so it reads as empty.

sources.name: European Cultural Foundation — open calls
sources.query: European Cultural Foundation open call fellowship 2027
sources.notes: culturalfoundation.eu/open-calls/ is a stub; calls get their own pages.

sources.name: Art a part of cult(ure) — bandi in scadenza
sources.notes: Cleanest Italian list: dated deadlines.

sources.name: GAI Giovani Artisti Italiani — concorsi
sources.notes: Filterable by sector (Video & Sound Art, Musica Elettronica). Many under-35 limits: check age.

sources.name: Theatron 2.0 — bandi e audizioni
sources.notes: High volume, mostly theatre/dance; keep residencies, festival calls and site-specific.

sources.name: Artribune — opportunità
sources.notes: Roundup articles: open the last 3-4, deadlines are in the body.

sources.name: Teatro e Critica — bandi e concorsi
sources.notes: Site blocks automated reading.

sources.name: MiC — Creatività Contemporanea (Italian Council, avvisi)
sources.notes: Homepage block 'Avvisi pubblici e premi'. National portal (unverified): https://portalebandidgcc.cultura.gov.it/

sources.name: Fondazione Cariplo — bandi
sources.notes: Site blocks automated reading. Usually organisation-only: propose only with a partner route.

sources.name: Fondazione con il Sud — bandi
sources.query: Fondazione con il Sud bando cultura 2027
sources.notes: Site blocks automated reading. Organisation-only (Curva Minore route, Sicily).

sources.name: Compagnia di San Paolo — bandi
sources.query: Compagnia di San Paolo bando arti 2027
sources.notes: Site blocks automated reading.

sources.name: SONITUS — Centro Musica Modena
sources.query: SONITUS residenza Centro Musica Modena bando
sources.notes: Landscape + instrument residency, ideal fit. 2026 edition closed 18 Dec 2025, under 36 and Emilia-Romagna domicile: check 2027 terms.

sources.name: MAD Murate Art District — residenze
sources.notes: Florence (TAB tie). Last edition closed 7 Jan 2026.

sources.name: Fotografia Europea — open call
sources.notes: Dysographies. Last edition opened ~20 Nov, closed 9 Jan, €25 fee, €3,000 production.

sources.name: ŻiguŻajg festival (Malta) — call
sources.notes: Playground fit. 2027 call closed 30 Nov 2026.

sources.name: La Baracca – Testoni Ragazzi — Visioni
sources.query: Visioni festival prima infanzia La Baracca masterclass bando
sources.notes: Bologna, early years 0-6 (Playground). Masterclass call closed 15 Oct 2026.

sources.name: Il Castello dei Mutamenti — residenza
sources.notes: Arcidosso (existing tie). Under 36; 2027 closed 30 Nov 2026.

sources.name: Segesta Teatro Festival — call
sources.notes: Trapani. Call page /call2027/ (server error when checked).

sources.name: CTM Festival — open calls
sources.notes: Update the year in the url each autumn. Lab calls close Sep-Nov.

sources.name: Wave Farm — residencies and fellowships
sources.notes: Transmission/radio art. Deadline 1 Dec.

sources.name: Akademie der Künste — Studio für Elektroakustische Musik
sources.notes: Two windows: deadline 31 Jan (Apr-Jun) and 30 Jun (Sep-Nov).

sources.name: Prix Ars Electronica + open calls
sources.notes: Prix submissions start early January.

sources.name: Ars Electronica Forum Wallis — call
sources.query: Forum Wallis call for acousmatic works
sources.notes: Fixed-media works only. Homepage is out of date.

sources.name: NAISA — calls for submissions
sources.notes: Next call announced March 2027.

sources.name: Phonurgia Nova — awards
sources.notes: Radio/sound art awards, June deadline.

sources.name: Biennale College Musica
sources.notes: Called in January, closes mid-February. Was under 30 in 2026: check.

sources.name: Medialab Matadero — convocatorias
sources.notes: Calls published April or July, close Aug-Sep.

sources.name: Q-O2 — residencies
sources.notes: Already tracked in calls.json; listed here so a new cycle gets noticed.

sources.name: IRCAM — artistic research residency
sources.notes: No call section on the homepage.

sources.name: Sonic Acts — open calls
sources.notes: No call section on the homepage.
